core_categories: Medical Simulation Supplies; Healthcare Education Products; Manikins & Simulators; Simulated Medications; Diagnostic Equipment
specialty_focus: Pocket Nurse is a nurse-owned manufacturer and distributor specializing in healthcare simulation and education supplies. It targets nursing, EMS, pharmacy, and allied health programs, providing over 5,600 products including manikins, simulators, and simulated medications to reduce medical errors through realistic training. It does not appear to deal in wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Demo Dose, Laerdal, Gaumard, Nasco, DiaMedical USA, others
